info.name: Pure activity externalOrganization API
externalOrganization
Lists all external organizations

params.name: size
params.description: Number of returned external organizations per request.

params.name: offset
params.description: The offset for the returned list. 0 or null value is from the start

params.name: order
params.description: The order of the list, must be a value from /external-organizations/orderings

items.docs: Lists all external organizations in the Pure instance. If you need to filter the external organizations returned, see the POST version which supports additional filtering.

info.name: Query operation for external organizations

items.docs: Lists external organizations in the Pure instance that matches the provided query, similar to the GET version, instead of using parameters to alter the response, an JSON document is posted with the request. The JSON document contains fields for all the parameters available for the GET version, but also additional filtering options.
